title: I Hope Google Doesn’t Ban Us... - Abusing Unlimited Google Drive
summary: Linus Tech Tips backs up their petabyte server to Google's unlimited G Suite Drive plan and runs into the daily upload cap. It shows how far the 'unlimited' offer can be pushed.
why: Cited as an example of data hoarders testing Google's unlimited storage and of Google rate limiting heavy use.

quote.text: relevant video on this unlimited plan and the way it is capped.
